personality: 6 Glass / Luxe structure with 8 Hand-Drawn / Journal textures (Custom: Premium Medieval Fantasy)
personality_one_liner: A regal, premium medieval-fantasy experience where players visibly evolve from a lone warrior to a royal commander against a backdrop of aged parchment, dark wood, and forged iron.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing for readability, but tighter in game HUDs. UI panels use thick embossed margins to mimic carved frames.

do's: Use heavy tinted glass (≥80% opacity iron gray or deep navy) over battlefield/map views for HUD overlays.
Use subtle glass over parchment textures for premium modal popups.
dont's: Do not use hyper-modern frosted clear glass. Keep blurs dark and tinted with game palette (smoke/iron).

screens.name: Battle (Main Auto-Battler)
screens.purpose: Primary idle loop where the commander fights and earns rewards.

states.loading: Centered forged iron spinner with parchment background.
states.error: Parchment modal with red heraldic seal and retry button.

screens.layout: Top 15%: HUD with premium currency, health, stage progress, kill rewards. Middle 60%: 2.5D animated battlefield (scales from 1 warrior to armies based on progression). Bottom 25%: Action bar for manual skill triggers and quick upgrades. Embossed frames surround the HUD elements.

screens.name: Kingdom
screens.purpose: City-building base for resource generation and research.

states.empty: View of the base camp (Tier 1) before buildings are constructed.
states.error: Cannot load kingdom data, retry overlay.

screens.layout: Full-screen isometric view of 16 buildings. Buildings have floating timer bars (wood/iron texture) for construction queues. Tapping a building opens an ornate parchment-styled Bottom Sheet with upgrade/production options.

screens.name: Domain
screens.purpose: Strategic 10x10 painted map for territorial expansion.

states.loading: Map unrolling animation or centered spinner.
states.empty: No tiles claimed - shows starting stronghold.

screens.layout: Pan-and-zoom painted map view. Top HUD shows Domain-specific resources. Ownership colors clearly mark territory. Tapping a hex opens a side/bottom panel with tile details (fort, village) and attack/claim actions.

screens.name: Army & Gear (Inventory/Forge)
screens.purpose: Manage the Lord's 9 gear slots, rarities, and 13 unit formations.

states.empty: No gear equipped silhouette of the Lord.

screens.layout: Split layout or sub-tabs. Top half: 2.5D render of the Lord. Surrounding: 9 gear slots with thick rarity-colored frames (Common -> Ancient). Bottom half: Scrollable inventory grid with Auto-Equip, Salvage, and Forge action buttons styled as heavy iron/stone presses.

screens.name: Social (Alliance & Events)
screens.purpose: Multiplayer interactions, chat, 19x19 Alliance war map, and boss hunts.

states.empty: 'Join an Alliance' call to action with a grand illustration of a banner.

screens.layout: Vertical list of Alliance members/events using heavy parchment cards with dark wood dividers. Chat is a persistent overlay or full-screen view with readable Satoshi text. War map follows the Domain layout but scaled for 19x19.

screens.name: Shop & Profile
screens.purpose: Monetization, Passes, Settings, and Account details.
screens.layout: Store uses rich visual cards: velvet backdrops for premium packs, antique gold borders for high-value items. Profile/Settings use a standard vertical list but with stone/wood UI toggles instead of native iOS switches.

parchment_background.alt: Aged parchment and dark wood textures for UI backgrounds

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a premium, medieval-fantasy UI. DO NOT use standard SaaS minimalist cards. Every panel should feel like parchment, wood, stone, or iron.
Implement the custom 'game_rarities' and 'game_resources' hex colors into the theme.ts file so they are universally available for gear borders and resource icons.
The core Battle screen must utilize a mobile-optimized Idle RPG layout: Top HUD for status, Center for the 2.5D visual action, and Bottom for high-frequency actions (skills, upgrades).
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) for all headings, titles, and numbers to give a regal/historic feel, while using 'Satoshi' (sans-serif) for body text and chat for strict readability.
Borders are thicker than usual mobile apps (e.g., 2pt-4pt for gear frames) to simulate forged iron or embossed gold.
Ensure the bottom navigation includes the exact 5 tabs required: Battle, Kingdom, Domain, Army, Social. Use heraldic-style iconography or heavy filled icons.
Strict adherence to user constraints: No cyberpunk/sci-fi elements, no generic placeholders, no 'slot-machine' aesthetics. Respect the requested Deep Navy/Burgundy/Gold color scheme.
